$comment: The community plugin index. One entry per plugin that somebody outside the
Grit team wrote and wants listed.
This file is the single source of truth: the CLI embeds it for
`grit plugin list`, and docs/scripts/sync-community-plugins.py copies it
into the docs site for the marketplace page. Edit it here and nowhere else.
To add yours, see `grit plugin submit` or
Listing is not endorsement, and the review is deliberately shallow: that
the repository exists, that it holds a plugin.json, that the plugin
installs and removes cleanly on a fresh project, and that it is not
obviously hostile. Nobody audits the code for you. It writes files into
your project and you should read them, the same as any dependency.
